editorial:
You follow Mallory Kane, a black ops soldier who gets double-crossed by her own boss and left for dead after a job goes sideways. Instead of running, she fights back, tracking down every person who sold her out. The movie has a cool, stripped-down vibe with realistic fight scenes that feel like real brawls, not flashy superhero stuff. Gina Carano carries the whole thing with her physical presence, and the supporting cast is stacked with big names like Michael Fassbender, Ewan McGregor, and Michael Douglas.

The action is the real star here. The fights are brutal and grounded, and the pacing keeps you moving from one showdown to the next. On the downside, the story can feel a little thin and the dialogue sometimes flat, so if you want deep character drama this might not be your pick. But if you want a lean, no-nonsense action thriller, this delivers. It is great for fans of realistic combat and revenge stories. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Mallory learns her boss Kenneth set her up to take the fall for a botched mission. She tracks him down and confronts him, revealing the full betrayal. After a tense showdown, she gets her payback and clears her name. The movie ends with Mallory sitting calmly at a diner with her father, finally free and at peace, having taken down everyone who crossed her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves realistic fight scenes and revenge thrillers.
